## Concerns
- Claims 1–2 establish only the linkage through Lemma 2.5 and Theorems 4.4–4.5.
- Claims 3–5 correctly identify that the central retrieval failed: equations (8)–(10) and Definition 2.1 remain truncated.
- The report correctly distinguishes “valid \(\varphi\)” as a theorem hypothesis from the two \(N\)-branches as proof-only cases, and explicitly states that the target is not established.
- Nevertheless, the acceptance criterion requires actual retrieval of one uncorrupted alternate-provider excerpt; an accurate failure report does not complete that criterion.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Retrieve one bounded, uncorrupted source-29 full-text excerpt from a provider other than the corrupted persisted extraction, with stable locator and digest, containing complete equations (8)–(10), every Definition 2.1 valid-tuple inequality, Lemma 2.5, and Theorems 4.4–4.5.
